program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
